text:
anya: noticed a weirdness in the python SDK sampleapp during onboarding: when the client hits concurrent concurrency limits (rate limit + token refresh) the paginator sometimes spins and emits repeated empty pages. Debug info below.

ted.h: empty pages? like server returns empty but next_cursor present?

anya: yes, exactly. flow: request page -> 429 Retry-After -> SDK retries after auth refresh -> server returns 200 with empty items and next_cursor advances -> pager doesn't realize it's empty and keeps fetching until depth limit. After few iterations the app shows a long spinner and user abandons.

shawn: are empty pages expected for some datasets?

anya: not in this dataset. Likely a combination of stale cursor replay + improper detection of end-of-stream.

bot-ci: created ticket DEVEX-1510: "python-sdk: paginator loop can spin on empty pages when auth+429 race"

ted.h: interim: add a guard in sampleapp to stop after N empty pages and surface a debugging banner. Long-term: SDK should validate that an empty items + advanced cursor is legit and emit a telemetry event if it looks suspicious.

anya: adding to runbook and sampleapp quickfix. assigning @shawn to help with python-sdk unit test.

shawn: will add tests and small fix. :white_check_mark:
